inputs.doc: E-043f · Trains a FRESH 38.0M daily codec on ALL 481 longitude columns, so the -45..-25 mid-Atlantic block (25.0% of the domain's ocean pixels) enters stage-1 training instead of being withheld — the daily arm of the wave-8 no-longitude-holdout regime change · params 38.0M · stage encoder · data family5_na025_daily · arch 512x12 d_z 32 heads 4 d_dec 256 patch 1 · steps 200000 x batch 512 · resume none (from scratch, recipe f5-40M-nolonhold). HYPOTHESIS: the withheld block is a quarter of the ocean and the daily codec is starved of it, so returning it lifts the linear section probe out of its flat band and gives it a trend. FALSIFIER: a final linear_r_deseas inside 0.558-0.598, or flat to within +/-0.02 across steps 7500-200000 — that would say the daily ceiling is set by cadence or capacity, not by the training pool, and the regime change buys the daily arm nothing. PRIOR AND CONTROL: #410 (E-038c daily codec, cancelled at step 67000 of 200000) is the withheld-block control at this exact architecture — its linear_r_deseas was FLAT in 0.558-0.598 with NO trend through step 67000, its last full probe (step 60000) reading linear_r_deseas 0.582, linear_r_raw 0.602, temporal_r_deseas 0.627, chan_vs_persistence 28.1%. FIRSTS AND CAVEATS: this is the first daily codec to reach a probe ladder at all — #389 (E-038c, the first daily attempt) wedged 7 h in the anomaly transform and #400/#410 (its two re-runs) were both cancelled mid-training — so the daily-scale ladder is UNTESTED and its cost unmeasured. Expected train pixels ~1.23e9, ~4/3 of #389's ~9.25e8. BUDGET: 200000 steps at #410's measured 217.4 ms/step is 12.1 h of training, but probes are 62% of loop wall clock at daily cadence (28 full evals at ~2293 s + 13 light probes at ~609 s), so the loop is ~32.5 h = 1947 min. max_minutes 2600, NOT #389/#410's 2200: 2200 sits only 2% above the point at which fit_schedule silently re-fits the cosine, the failure #386 (E-038a, the f4-40M pentad control) hit when 200000 became 166752. job_timeout 3400 leaves ~600 min for the unmeasured daily ladder.
